translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: «Hawaa ubbaa ta ayifii be'eedda; ta haytsaykka sisiide akeekeedda.
Hintte eriyaawaa taanikka eray; taani hintteppe laafikke.
Shin taani Ubbaa Danddayiyaa S'oossaw haasayanaw koyay; hinttenanna gidenna. Taani ta mootuwaa aanana mootettanaw amottay.
Hintte tumuwaa wordduwaan kammiita; hintte ubbaykka patsenna aakimatuwaa.
Hintte ubbay c'o"u geedda gideerikkiteeshsha! Yaatintto, hinttena Asay aad'd'eeda eranchcha gaana shin!
«Ha"i ta mootuwaa sisite; ta doonaappe kesiyaa palumiyaa hayzzite.
Hintte S'oossaa doonaa gidiide, wordduwaa haasayiiteeyye? Aa diraw ek'k'iide, c'imuwaa haasayiiteeyye?
Hintte Aa maaddiyaawe de'ii? Woy aw abakkaatto gidiide mootettiitee?
I hinttena pilggi s'eellintto, hintteppe lo"obaa demmanee? Hintte asaa c'immiyaawaadan, Aa c'immanaw danddayiiteeyye?
Hintte geeman asaa som"uwaa s'eelliide maaddooppe, S'oossay tumu hinttena seerana.
Aa bonchchuu hinttena dagantsennee? Aa anggay hinttena yashshennee?
Hintte odiyaa leemisotuu bidintsaa mala patsennawantta; hintte shiishshiyaa palumii urk'k'aappe med'etteedda gonddalliyaa mala.
«Ane c'o"u giite! haasayana; hawaappe guyyiyaan, bare hanowaa hano.
Taani ta huup'iyaa ayaw hirggaa garssan wotsaytaa? Ta shemppuwaakka ayaw ta kushiyaan oyk'k'aytaa?
Be'ite, S'oossay taana wod'iyaawaa gidooppenne, taani Aa danddayan naagana. Gidooppenne, taani ta mootuwaa Aa sintsa shiishshana.
Nagaranchcha Asay Aa sintsa shiik'anaw danddayenna diraw; hawe taani shiik'anaw s'aliyaawe, ooni erii, ta atotetsaw gaaso gidanaw danddayee.
Ta haasayaa akeekiide sisite; taani odiyaawe hintte haytsaan gelo.
Be'ite, taani ta mootuwaa giigissaaddi; shatimmanawaakka eray.
«Abeet S'oossaw, neeni taana mootanaw yay? Neeni taana bayzzanchcha kessooppe, taani c'o"u gaade hayk'k'ana.
Shin neeni taw ha laa"ubatuwaa ootsa; taani neeppe geemmikke.
Taana muriyaawaa agga; ne anggaan taana dagantsoppa.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, taana s'eesa; taani koyana. Woy taani haasayina, taw zaaraadde haasaya.
Barew, taani bayzzeedda bayzzuunne nagaray aappunee? Ta balaanne ta nagaraa ane taana bessa.
«Neeni ayaw ne som"uwaa taappe gentsay? K'ay taana ayaw ne morkkiyaadan payday?
Taana, c'arkkuu afiyaa bonc'c'iyaa malaa, yashissayii? Woy meleedda suullaa malaa yederssay?
Neeni ta bolla s'aafeedda mootuu c'ama; haray attina, taani yalagatetsan de'aadde ootseedda bayzzuwaanne ashshabaakka.
Neeni ta gediyaa gediyaa birataan k'achchaadda; ta tanggiyaa tangguwaa ubbaa wochchaasa; ta gediyaa kottiyaa pilgga s'eellaasa.
Taani wook'k'eeddabaadan hanay; bil"ay meedda afilaadankka wook'k'ay.
